items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And he went up to New York with my cousin, Harold Dejan.

ctx.x: He was teaching at Craig School, Joseph A. Craig, and that’s when my dad was going to school, so Willie talked to my grandfather about getting my dad an instrument. He said, “Man, you know, that kid’s got some talent somewhere man, you should get him an instrument.” So they bought him a trumpet and he really progressed on trumpet. So he had gotten skipped two grades, so he graduated from high school when he was 15. And he went up to New York with my cousin, Harold Dejan. You know of him?
